$description: The migration plan, one source: each legacy page type's Astro template and components, and which routes are ported (done = built here and pixel-compared at <= 3%). scripts/migration.mjs writes MIGRATION.md's inventory from this and src/data/legacy/routes.json.

home.components: Hero (in page), stats row, BrickCard, CodeBlock, Key; 14 sections kept as built (Html)
home.wave: W2-home: componentize origin, play, story, profile, contract, board, loop, recall, specs, ship, games, roadmap, start, final

doc.components: Crumbs, SectionHead, CodeBlock, Key, DocSteps, DocsSidebar
doc.wave: W2-docs: add the slug to export-legacy.mjs (guides need a guides/[slug] route on the same template), then compare

brick.components: Crumbs, CodeBlock; the head, demo, card and API kept as built (Html)
brick.wave: W2-bricks: add the ids to export-legacy.mjs, then compare; later an ApiDecl component for the API

bricks-index.components: BrickCard, SymChip, periodic table + stickers + factory (Html until componentized)

gallery-index.components: GalleryView: Crumbs, SectionHead, Callout, GalleryThemes (chips + filter script), GallerySearch (search script), GalleryCard, GalleryPages
gallery-index.wave: W2-gallery done; next: each card's stage and meta tail (kept as built) as components

gallery-archive.template: src/pages/gallery/archive/index.astro (GalleryView, theme sections; noindex,nofollow on every build)

brand.components: Lockup, Mark, Key, token swatches (new, from tokens.json)

redirect.template: to build: a redirect (Cloudflare _redirects 301, plus the meta-refresh page)

demo.template: to build: the engine demos' own host pages (no site shell for some)
demo.components: kept as built (Html) until the demos build from @fzlt/core here
